manager_frozen_notice: This season is frozen because registration was opened on it. Stages are shown for reference only, and the server will refuse any addition, edit, deletion or reordering.
load_error: Could not load this season's stages. Close and reopen this dialog to try again.
empty: This season has no stages yet. The server will not allow registration to open before at least one stage exists and has a judging rule.
order_unsaved_note: This order has not been saved yet. The final numbers are assigned on save.
delete_body: The "{{name}}" stage will be deleted permanently. Deletion is only available for stages nothing references yet, and cannot be undone. The other stages keep their current numbers.
form_append_notice: The stage will be added at the end of the order. Use the arrows in the stage list to move it.
form_translations_note: The Arabic name is required now. Having all three languages and the public names is checked by the server when registration opens, so they can be filled in later.
rules_title: Stage judging rules for the {{year}} season
rules_load_error: Could not load the stages, their rules, or the score systems. Rules cannot be set before they load — close and reopen this dialog to try again.
rules_no_stages: This season has no stages yet. Add the stages from the stages screen first, then come back to set their judging rules.
rules_frozen_notice: This season is frozen. The rules are shown for reference only, and the server will refuse any save.
rules_intro: Every stage needs exactly one rule. Leave the qualification percentage empty if the stage ranks contestants without eliminating anyone — which is the usual case for a final stage.
create_error: Could not add the stage. Check the details.
update_error: Could not update the stage. Check the details.
reorder_error: Could not save the stage order.
rules_error: Could not save the stage rules. Check the details.
err_stage_in_use: This stage cannot be deleted because data is linked to it (judging rules, judge assignments, streams, applications or results). Deletion is only available for stages that have not been used yet.
err_season_frozen: This season is frozen because registration was opened on it, and its stages can no longer be changed.
err_invalid_order: The submitted stage order is not valid. It must list every stage of the season exactly once.
v_start_date_required: Please pick a stage start date
v_end_date_required: Please pick a stage end date
v_name_ar_required: Please enter the stage name in Arabic
v_end_after_start: The stage must end after it starts
v_score_system_required: Please choose a score system for this stage
v_percentage_range: The qualification percentage must be a number between 0 and 100
